node.statement: On the convex coordinate box ||a||<2c*delta, ||q||<3delta/2, lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control supplies the C^1 map A(a)=a+g_V(a), with ||Dg_V||<=C_ch*(epsilon_r+c*delta), and the previous child supplies L_V^{-1}. Exact unitality and bilinearity give p_V(a,q)=A(a)+q+L_V^{-1}((V bold-dot A(a)) bold-dot q). Its derivative at (a,q) applied to (alpha,beta) is alpha+beta+Dg_V(a)alpha+L_V^{-1}((V bold-dot(alpha+Dg_V(a)alpha)) bold-dot q)+L_V^{-1}((V bold-dot A(a)) bold-dot beta). The epsilon-C*-product bound, the universal bounds on V and L_V^{-1}, ||q||=O(delta), and ||A(a)||<=||a||+||g_V(0)||+sup||Dg_V||*||a||=O(delta) (using the graph lemma's bound on g_V(0) and ||V^dagger bold-dot V-J||<=2c*delta) therefore give ||Dp_V-I||<=C_0*(epsilon_r+delta), for the max norm on icalH x calH and the corresponding sum map (alpha,beta) maps to alpha+beta. Choosing the universal root guard so that C_0*(epsilon_r+delta)<=1/4 yields theta:=sup||Dp_V-I||<=1/4. Thus the derivative hypothesis used in node 1.2.1 is established here directly from the sole allowed external lemma and the registered definitions, without importing pending sibling node 1.1.2.
